model: Unchanged embedded frozen factorized motor from Geometry8 source; original causal185 plus action/timing. All neural forward and numerical comparisons CUDA only.
membership: Only admitted context intervention frames. Require exactly one actual native MG shot in the same exclusive dispatch window. Missing/multiple shots are reported, never fabricated or replaced with next-observation poses.
target: Actual native muzzle displacement relative to current observed centered muzzle, rotated into OLD observed yaw frame and scaled32, as in the predictor's original supervised target. Native pose is labels only.
comparisons: Report absolute horizontal muzzle error against zero and constant-velocity100ms. For each alternative with a shot and its own control with a shot, compare predicted and actual horizontal displacement differences. Zero-delta baseline means no action effect. Also measure native muzzle XY versus next observation XY to check timing, without assuming equality.
interpretation: Passing only supports exploratory use of predicted motor geometry as features, not a useful maneuver selector or better battle quality. Failure requires understanding timing/coverage/model error before trusting this geometry. No new training/games/default changes.
